cases.question: ¿Cuánto se facturó por cada tipo de comprobante en mayo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type, SUM(si.total_amount) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY si.voucher_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT si.voucher_type AS tipo_comprobante, COALESCE(SUM(si.total_amount), 0) AS total_facturado FROM public.sales_invoice AS si WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY si.voucher_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuánto se cobró por cada medio de pago en mayo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio, SUM(sp.amount) AS total FROM sales_payment sp JOIN payment_type pt ON pt.id = sp.payment_type_id WHERE sp.paid_at >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND sp.paid_at < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY pt.id, pt.name ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT pt.name AS medio_pago, COALESCE(SUM(sp.amount), 0) AS total_cobrado FROM public.sales_payment AS sp JOIN public.payment_type AS pt ON sp.payment_type_id = pt.id WHERE sp.paid_at >= CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE) AND sp.paid_at < CAST('2026-06-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY pt.name LIMIT 50
